text.name: Invasion of Iraq
text.rules: Record "coalition fractures" for the rest of the game. SAE spends 2 points. If SAE played this card, until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1. Raise Escalation by 1.
text.history: A US-led coalition invaded Iraq on 20 March 2003 and took Baghdad on 9 April 2003. The stated justification, Iraqi weapons of mass destruction, was not borne out.
